description: Query product-breakdown insights and enrich rows with Product Catalog metadata when catalog access is available.

catalogId.description: Product Catalog ID used to load product metadata for joins.

catalogProductLimit.description: Maximum catalog product records read for the join.

datePreset.description: Insights date preset. Defaults to last_30d.

level.description: Entity or aggregation level for the requested report.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

metrics.description: Native or documented calculated metric names to request. Check compatibility with the selected dimensions.

productBreakdown.description: Native product grouping used to join catalog items with reported insights.

name: meta_join_product_insights

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: meta join product insights
